title: Canadian Customs Tariff 2026 (T2026-2), Chapter 87
notes: Live rendered-page readback on 2026-10-22. Chapter 87 lists bicycles and other non-motorized cycles under heading 87.12 and their parts and accessories under a separate heading 87.14, with treatments that differ by tariff agreement. No classification or rate is inferred here for a particular buyer's frame, frameset or complete bike.
